states.name: media-job: QUEUED
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: accepted and durably registered; no attempt currently owns execution

states.name: media-job: RUNNING
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: at least one current fenced attempt is executing an admitted stage

states.name: media-job: RETRY_PENDING
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: prior attempt ended in a classified retryable outcome and bounded retry authority remains

states.name: media-job: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: an external effect may have occurred but its result is not known

states.name: media-job: RECONCILING
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: provider, store, or operator evidence is being checked before a safe next action

states.name: media-job: COMPLETED
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: verified outputs are registered and satisfy the accepted result contract

states.name: media-job: PARTIALLY_SUCCEEDED
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: a declared subset succeeded and the remaining work has a recorded disposition

states.name: media-job: FAILED
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: no eligible continuation remains and failure truth is persisted

states.name: media-job: CANCELLED
states.description: one logical accepted processing request and its product-level finality: cancellation finality is confirmed for all effects that could still mutate this job

states.name: media-attempt: CLAIMED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: worker owns a valid lease and fencing token

states.name: media-attempt: DISPATCH_INTENT_RECORDED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: durable intent and idempotency identity exist before external dispatch

states.name: media-attempt: DISPATCHED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: external request may have crossed the boundary

states.name: media-attempt: RUNNING
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: execution is observed as active by the attempt owner

states.name: media-attempt: CANCEL_REQUESTED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: stop was requested; the effect is not yet known to be stopped

states.name: media-attempt: SUCCEEDED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: provider returned an outcome that still requires result validation and registration

states.name: media-attempt: FAILED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: attempt failure is classified and recorded

states.name: media-attempt: CANCEL_CONFIRMED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: provider or local execution authority confirms no further mutation from this attempt

states.name: media-attempt: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: attempt may have produced external work or cost without a confirmable result

states.name: media-attempt: SUPERSEDED
states.description: one fenced execution attempt for a stage or provider dispatch: a newer fence owns writes; this attempt cannot commit

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: RECEIVING
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: bounded ordered upload parts are being accepted

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: VERIFYING
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: expected length, per-part integrity, full digest, policy, and detected format are being checked

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: AVAILABLE
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: verified artifact bytes and metadata may be referenced by authorized jobs

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: QUARANTINED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: content is isolated pending security, rights, policy, or format review

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: REJECTED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: admission or verification failed; the artifact is not usable

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: EXPIRED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: retention expiry has elapsed and physical cleanup is due or in progress

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: ERASURE_REQUESTED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: authorized erasure intent is durably recorded

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: ACCESS_REVOKED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: new reads, reuse, and dispatch are blocked while erasure work proceeds

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: PHYSICAL_ERASURE_PENDING
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: bytes, derivatives, metadata, caches, and declared replicas are being removed or reconciled

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: BLOCKED_BY_HOLD
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: an active lawful or policy hold prevents some or all physical erasure

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: ERASURE_CONFIRMED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: every in-scope controlled copy has verifiable deletion evidence

states.name: media-upload-and-artifact: EXTERNAL_ERASURE_UNCONFIRMED
states.description: receive, verify, promote, retain, and erase immutable media artifacts: Media cannot confirm deletion of a remote or recipient-held copy

states.name: media-stream-session: OPEN
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: session has an authorized provider and persisted token hash

states.name: media-stream-session: CONNECTED
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: current connection holds a valid short reconnect lease

states.name: media-stream-session: DEGRADED
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: stream can continue only under its declared bounded degradation rules

states.name: media-stream-session: DRAINING
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: close fences new frames and active work is being terminated

states.name: media-stream-session: CLOSED
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: no new frames or reconnects are accepted and provider close is recorded

states.name: media-stream-session: FAILED
states.description: govern ordered, reconnectable media streams with explicit close and frame finality: the stream cannot continue; accepted frames and uncertain remote effects remain auditable

states.name: media-project: ACTIVE
states.description: model the project container lifecycle independently from jobs, immutable revisions, membership, and authorization: The project is open for authorized inspection and versioned change under its current head revision.

states.name: media-project: ARCHIVED
states.description: model the project container lifecycle independently from jobs, immutable revisions, membership, and authorization: The project is retained but excluded from ordinary active-work views; source and revision history remain immutable.

states.name: media-project-version: DRAFT
states.description: model mutable edit drafts, immutable committed project revisions, optimistic concurrency, branch/restore, and conflict disposition: A mutable candidate revision based on an explicit parent/head revision; it is not the canonical project head.

states.name: media-project-version: COMMITTED
states.description: model mutable edit drafts, immutable committed project revisions, optimistic concurrency, branch/restore, and conflict disposition: An immutable revision atomically accepted as the current project head after expected-head comparison and validation.

states.name: media-project-version: SUPERSEDED
states.description: model mutable edit drafts, immutable committed project revisions, optimistic concurrency, branch/restore, and conflict disposition: An immutable previously committed revision that is no longer the project head; retained for authorized history/branch/restore.

states.name: media-project-version: CONFLICTED
states.description: model mutable edit drafts, immutable committed project revisions, optimistic concurrency, branch/restore, and conflict disposition: An immutable commit attempt rejected because the expected head was stale or a declared merge constraint failed.

states.name: media-project-version: ABANDONED
states.description: model mutable edit drafts, immutable committed project revisions, optimistic concurrency, branch/restore, and conflict disposition: An uncommitted draft explicitly abandoned or expired without changing the project head.

states.name: media-project-membership: INVITED
states.description: model the project-scoped membership relationship while leaving identity, authentication, and authorization decisions with their public owners: A scoped membership invitation exists but has not been accepted or activated.

states.name: media-project-membership: ACTIVE
states.description: model the project-scoped membership relationship while leaving identity, authentication, and authorization decisions with their public owners: An accepted membership relationship exists; every action is still checked against current grants and project policy.

states.name: media-project-membership: SUSPENDED
states.description: model the project-scoped membership relationship while leaving identity, authentication, and authorization decisions with their public owners: The relationship is retained but project actions are blocked pending authorized reactivation or revocation.

states.name: media-project-membership: REVOKED
states.description: model the project-scoped membership relationship while leaving identity, authentication, and authorization decisions with their public owners: The membership relationship is ended; prior actions remain auditable and access is re-evaluated at every boundary.

states.name: media-project-membership: EXPIRED
states.description: model the project-scoped membership relationship while leaving identity, authentication, and authorization decisions with their public owners: An invitation expired without becoming active.

inspections.description: Inspect the currently authored and versioned Media interface, screen, CLI, SDK, Agent Tool or event contract; proposal and admitted implementation must be visibly distinct.
Inspect the exact artifact, project, version, rights/consent and caller scope without revealing content outside current policy.
Inspect available quality, provenance, result and external delivery evidence with metric domains, sources and UNKNOWN/NOT_QUALIFIED distinguished from measured failure.
Inspect causal job, attempt, dispatch, provider and delivery statuses across observations without manufacturing finality or permissions.
Inspect deterministic experience scenario inputs and expected transitions as explicitly synthetic examples, never production media evidence or provider qualification.

recoverySourceCrossReferences.rationale: Recovery permits manual correction or retaining a draft; the linked fixture has uncertain transcript language and the action edits caption text without asserting recognition certainty.
Recovery permits explicit time-range entry or retaining a draft; the linked fixture has a missing segment end time.
The linked fixture denies processing after consent revocation; the exact action is the guarded processing request whose effect must remain blocked.
The recovery path names observing or checking the existing job; both actions are read-only and the fixture preserves OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
The recovery path preserves both versions and requires an explicit resolution; the linked fixture has concurrent caption versions and a conflicted draft.

reasons: Required public component props are not supplied by component anatomy; the candidate leaves requiredProps empty rather than reclassifying anatomy as props.
View identity, purpose, and exact resolvable component refs are projected; screen journey refs use J-xx source IDs with no schema-shaped journeys, and PDP-1 state refs remain unbound.

P0-04 resolves 11 of 30 initiating actors, while 19 remain unresolved; the public journey projection still lacks schema-shaped per-step intent/transition bindings and exact ordered step IDs, so no P3 journey is emitted.
PDP-0 transition proposals lack resolved PDP-1 actionRefs and guard references; the P1 state/operation owners have not accepted a legal source-to-target binding.
The 146 UI action records supply exact labels, prose, and preconditions, but do not select canonical PDP-1 operationRefs or exact action-to-effect bindings for producesEffectRefs.

The action source does not classify each effect into the public effect-kind enum; six reversible values are conditional prose while the schema requires a boolean, so those cannot be narrowed without owner decisions.

Only actions whose confirmation prose explicitly requires confirmation and whose reversible field is a boolean have a candidate finality record; other confirmation wording and conditional reversibility remain unresolved.

Five recovery narratives and exact action/scenario cross-references are retained in source review metadata; the source does not provide the public automaticRecovery/userActionRequired booleans or all canonical state/finality references.
Only 14 of 31 registry records have an exact source-fixture state that maps to a canonical PDP-0 state; 17 remain unresolved, and context dimensions are not asserted.
Only fixtures with a projected linked scenario and an exact fixture key in the local simulation source are emitted; records carry source descriptors, not an inlined executable payload.

derivationBoundary: candidateModel is a structurally conformant partial projection populated from direct source records where mappings exist. Empty collections represent unresolved mappings, never accepted non-applicability. Where a contract requires generated timestamps, they are projection-build metadata rather than canonical product timestamps; optional ProductDefinition timestamps are omitted when source provenance is absent. Source facts remain proposals until owners accept the mappings; this artifact does not claim semantic completeness, phase acceptance, or currentness.
knownBlockers: The required ExperienceDefinition shape is populated from exact PDP sources wherever direct mappings exist; exact remaining semantic, cross-reference, and acceptance blockers stay listed separately.
